snippet.title: Hiyah GO!  – A new kind of multiplayer experience [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
Hiyah GO! is a battle royale set on a massive open island.
Explore the map, capture a monster, and fight to reach Top 1 with your companion by your side.

Link : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4237080/Hiyah_Go

Only one summoner and one monster can win.

Voice-Based Combat & Evolution

Trigger attacks, healing, and defensive abilities using your voice.
Timing and positioning are key in every encounter.

Your monster can evolve up to two times, becoming stronger and unlocking powerful new attacks as the match progresses.

Capture a Monster, Fight Together

Land on the island and search for wild monster zones.
Capture a monster early and keep it with you for the entire match.

Each monster has unique abilities and combat roles.
Your survival depends on how well you choose and use your companion.

Secrets, Power & Progression
Explore the island to discover hidden, devastating attacks that can completely turn a fight.

Complete missions, unlock skins, and progress through a wide range of content.
Every match offers new opportunities, strategies, and rewards.

Features
Large-scale battle royale map

Monster capture and progression

Voice-controlled abilities

Monster evolutions with powerful attacks

Secret abilities hidden across the map

Missions, skins, and unlockable content

High-replayability matches

If you want next:

a short Steam “About This Game” version

exact GIF length & framing per section

or a more competitive / more casual tone
